welcome_format_help_msg: Welcome and goodbye messages can be formatted in HTML format or with Telegram's built-in text formatter. You can use the /html command to verify that your HTML is correct. You can use these arguments: - {id} to show the user ID. - {username} to show the user's username. If the user has no username, the bot shows a mention. - {first_name} to show the user's name. - {full_name} or {name} to show the user's full name. - {mention} to mention the user. - {chat_title} or {title} to show the chat title. - {count} to show the chat member count. - {profile_photo} or {user_photo} to send the user's latest profile photo with the message as caption. To add buttons, you can use [button text](buttonurl:button link). To add more buttons on the same line, add :same after the link, like this: [button text](buttonurl:button link:same).
